subject: auto-code-rover
title: Counterfactual dual-run review: reproducer executed with AND without the candidate patch, reviewer judges patch and test separately, feedback routed to whichever agent was wrong
evidence: app/api/review_manage.py:104-167 (dual execute_reproducer + per-side YES/NO branches); app/task.py:420-440 (reproducer run with/without patch); app/agents/agent_reviewer.py (patch_decision/test_decision split)
one_why: Clean-room concept (Sonar SA v1.0 license - concepts only): running the reproducer twice turns the reviewer's judgment from opinion into evidence, and splitting patch-vs-test blame means a bad test triggers a test rewrite instead of a wasted patch round - no corpus subject with a reviewer loop distinguishes 'your fix is wrong' from 'your probe is wrong'.

subject: auto-code-rover
title: No approval layer at all, and the primary documented workflow executes model-written code on the host by recommendation
evidence: app/task.py:431-437 (LLM-authored reproducer run via run_script_in_conda, only bound is timeout=120); README.md:209 ('we recommend setting up ACR on a host machine, instead of running it in docker mode'); grep approval|permission|confirm over app/ hits nothing
one_why: The Docker recommendation (README.md:110) is for the minimal demo path only; the SWE-bench/eval path - the reason the tool exists - tells users to run unsandboxed with API keys in env while model-generated Python executes as the user. Contrast with codel: codel at least claims isolation; ACR openly gives none.

subject: auto-code-rover
title: 927MB of checked-in SWE-bench run outputs (3,161 .diff blobs under results/) made the census report 2.6M LOC, primary_language 'diff', and suggested a T3 review of a 13.9k-LOC tool
evidence: results/acr-run-1/applicable_patch/*/*.diff (3,161 files, du results = 927M); cloc app=6,968 + test=6,141 + scripts=814 Python LOC
one_why: Second census-corruption archetype alongside deepagents: not test-glob misses but whole experiment outputs committed to the repo - census should exclude results|experiment|output dirs and cap file weights; left unchecked it 190x's the size and misroutes reviewer effort by two tiers.

subject: auto-code-rover
title: tenacity retry wraps the whole model call and re-fires deterministic failures (context_length_exceeded) 3 times at 30-600s random backoff before the caller can react
evidence: app/model/common.py:127 (@retry(wait_random_exponential(min=30,max=600), stop_after_attempt(3)) on call) with :176-177 catching context_length_exceeded only to log and re-raise; same pattern app/model/gpt.py:128
one_why: A deterministic 'prompt too long' error is not transient: each doomed retry adds up to 10 min wall time and 3x provider load, and the outer model-cycle fallback (app/inference.py:108-131) - which is the right response - is reached 3 retries late; retry policy must classify transient vs deterministic errors.

subject: auto-code-rover
title: Structured AST search interface: 8 tree-sitter-backed semantic APIs (search_class/method/in-file, get_code_around_line) instead of shell or grep tools, with arity asserted at dispatch
evidence: app/agents/agent_search.py:24-38 (API menu in prompt); app/search/search_backend.py:276 (search_class over tree-sitter index; requirements.txt:111-115); app/search/search_manage.py:160-167 (reflection dispatch with inspect.getfullargspec + assert on argument count)
one_why: Clean-room concept: the agent cannot read or write anything - its entire action space is read-only semantic queries, which bounds both damage and token blowup (RESULT_SHOW_LIMIT=3 per call, search_backend.py:22); the strongest example in the corpus of a deliberately closed tool surface earning the SWE-agent ACI idea.

evidence: app/inference.py:297-300 (config.enable_sbfl -> fault_localization()); app/agents/agent_search.py:103-106 ('You can choose to use the results from this tool, if you think they are useful'); app/analysis/sbfl.py:254 (PythonSbfl engine)
